## Historical Resume Instructions (Superseded)

The instructions below are preserved as a record of the former workflow.
They are not current guidance. See `Current Work State` for the active
translation priorities; do not restart sequential proper-name discovery.

1. Run `pwd` and treat the current working directory as the project root.
2. Read `PROJECT-AI.md`, `NEXT-SESSION.md`,
   `DISTRIBUTION_CHECKLIST.md`, and `TRANSLATION-ROLE.md`.
3. For translation review, edit only `work/zh_cn/`; update root or audit
   documentation when the task requires it. Verify CSV hashes before CSV edits.
   For a specific heuristic candidate, search `affix`, `base`, and `default`
   in both the active Korean files and matching source locales before
   deciding which resources contain applicable rows.
4. For translation review, do not inspect, search, extract, compare, or cite
   PAKs or PAK-derived files. English is the meaning anchor, Japanese informs
   voice/register, and Chinese is supporting evidence. Close source-faithful
   Korean as `not an issue`; accept evidence-backed corrections. Keep
   `uncertain` only for material ambiguity that changes the Korean and
   remains unresolved after one focused review. Do not repeat negative
   searches or retain holds merely because no new evidence appeared. Group by
   term/context and record a definite disposition for every reviewed row.
   Do not resume exhaustive proper-name discovery, sequential proper-name
   batches, or residual audits unless the user explicitly reopens them. The
   remaining translation review is limited to errors found during gameplay
   (with limited coverage) and heuristic searches for candidate translation
   errors. Fix clear errors and record unresolved items
   without turning them into an exhaustive name queue.
   Read the official Korean manual as a core source for overall setting,
   races, factions, deities, mechanics, and established Korean terminology.
   Consult relevant sections/pages for each applicable decision; exact-term
   searches only supplement contextual reading. Record relevant context.
   The manual is not exhaustive, and a no-hit alone is not grounds for
   uncertainty.
   Only the latest current checkpoint below is operative; the older
   checkpoints in this file are historical snapshots.
5. `work/ja_jp/` was deleted on 2026-10-14 at the user's direction. Do not
   assume its historical source files are still available.
6. Do not repeat completed research or translation. This workspace has a Git
   repository. Do not publish, build, replace, or install game files unless
   requested.

- **Font-format investigation resumed:** `src/font/` contains one `.font`
  metadata file and 28 `.ntx` pages, all with `FORK` magic. Page sizes match
  a possible 104-byte header followed by 512x512 data (last page 256x512),
  but header fields and pixel encoding are not yet decoded. Continue with
  read-only analysis and temporary derived images; do not edit `src/font/`.

- **DDS texture-format note (2026-10-14):** The user-provided
  [KoA-DDS-Encoder-GUI](https://github.com/PylkijSlon/KoA-DDS-Encoder-GUI)
  is a GUI front end for KoA PAK tools and Szlobi's KoA DDS encoder/decoder.
  Szlobi's [Re-Reckoning Modding Utility Toolbox (#15)](https://www.nexusmods.com/kingdomsofamalurrereckoning/mods/15)
  explicitly includes a KOARR file converter for converting game textures
  between custom KOARR and standard formats, plus symbol tables mapping
  asset IDs to names. The related [KOARR Toolbox (#31)](https://www.nexusmods.com/kingdomsofamalurrereckoning/mods/31)
  is a separately published modding-tool bundle by the same author; keep it
  as related context, but do not assume it is the same converter package.
  The GUI README describes decoding KoA DDS files to
  standard DDS for editing, then encoding edited standard DDS files back to
  KoA format; decoding does not itself imply PNG/JPG conversion. A read-only
  sample check found 420 `.dds` files in the extracted resource set.
  `1919268.dds` is 92,198 bytes; its header starts with the matching numeric
  resource ID, has 480x192 dimensions, and contains `KEEN` at byte offset 16
  rather than the standard `DDS ` magic. The `2502451_0` through `_4` files
  share the numeric ID and 2048x2048 header dimensions but range from 43,726
  to 2,796,230 bytes. Suffixes and size differences suggest separate texture
  variants, possibly quality/resolution variants, but their exact mapping
  and asset usage are unverified. Do not assume the suffixes are mip levels;
  identify individual assets through decoded images and resource/material
  references if needed.

## Invariants

- `src/` and `references/` are immutable. Do not edit, rename, move, or add
  generated files there. Keep `references/` out of Git/publication.
- English is the semantic authority; Japanese is the main voice/register,
  honorific, and line-layout reference; Chinese is a secondary cross-check.
  The official Korean manual is the terminology authority. Namu Wiki is
  tertiary context only.
- Russian is not a translation reference. Use `src/csv/ru_ru/` only for a
  specifically justified structural comparison.
- Preserve CSV keys, `Tipo_Variante`, duplicates, row order/count, delimiter,
  UTF-8 BOM, CRLF records, game tokens, markup, numeric values, and
  intentional line breaks. Edit only `Texto` during translation/review.
- For focused term/name consistency work, check `affix`, `base`, and
  `default`; do not assume a term is confined to the resource where it was
  previously found.
- `Tipo_Variante` semantics remain hypotheses. In particular, do not treat
  the proposed interpretations of `14` and `24` as confirmed engine rules.
- Do not claim archive or in-game validation until it has actually passed.

## Documents to Resume With

- `PROJECT-AI.md`: project boundaries, source hierarchy, invariants, and build
  safety.
- `DISTRIBUTION_CHECKLIST.md`: unresolved destination, package, validation,
  and release gates.
- `TRANSLATION-ROLE.md`: translator/reviewer/editor/verifier/builder
  separation.
- `work/zh_cn/TRANSLATION_PROGRESS.md`: active migration and review status.
- `work/zh_cn/audit/affix-extra-variant-review.tsv`: provisional extra
  variant candidates and cross-locale evidence.
- `work/zh_cn/audit/from-ja_jp/`: preserved historical progress and review
  records from the original draft.
- `README.md`: bilingual user-facing overview and workflow.
